cost_matrix.assumptions: FN = $500 avg fraud loss. FP = 5 analyst minutes @ $1/min = $5.

seed_variance_cost_note: F1 std=0.0249 across 20 seeds. Worst seed F1=0.8172. Under worst seed, assuming recall drops proportionally, FN count could rise ~25-30% (from 16 to ~20), adding ~$2,000 to model_cost per test slice. This is a material risk vs. the single-seed picture.
headline: Model saves $40,945 per test slice (~0.40 days) vs. flag-nothing baseline. That is $102,367/day.
